rca_of_issue: UI test blockage RCA: automation assumed direct login/home route, but app consistently rendered Welcome/Continue onboarding gate; script did not reliably transition to authenticated home before selector waits. This produced repeated home-scroll timeouts despite valid credentials and backend auth success. Mitigation: explicit state machine in Playwright (welcome -> continue -> auth route -> login -> onboarding completion check) before asserting screen-specific selectors.
